name: Bank Polska Kasa Opieki S.A.
summary: Bank Polska Kasa Opieki S.A., a commercial bank, provides banking products and services to retail and corporate clients in Poland. It operates through Retail Banking and Private Banking; Enterprise banking; and Corporate and Investment Banking segments. The company offers bank accounts, deposits and certificates of deposit, payment cards, loan products, mortgage and consumer loans, and insurance products. It is also involved in the brokering activity and sale of investment products; leasing, factoring, arranging issues of debt securities, and other specialized forms of financing; and transactional banking.
